description:
Sky Covington is a Hamtramck, Detroit based artist who won the coveted Motor City’s Jazz Vocalist of the year award in 2019 and 2020. She also has her own radio show om WJZZ, and hosts a weekly event at the legendary Baker’s Lounge jazz club.

She appears here under her famous NIKKI O pseudonym (best known for classics on Mahogani Music, alongside the likes of Moodymann and Alton Miller), returning to Shadeleaf for the “Rough, Rugged, Raw” album, initially a very special Bandcamp only release.

P & C Shadeleaf Music 2021.
credits:
Vocals by Sky Covington aka Nikki O.
Music, Engineering, Production etc. by 'monkz.

(Additional Instrumentation on "Black Sugar Honey" and "Bigger" by Pete Simpson, and "Syntaxe de l'amour" by Bennett Holland. Tape and scissors applied to "Gotta Believe In The Boogie" by Duckbeats.)
